topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: Hey, I just got this package today, and it's clearly not meant for me. Checked the label—yep, it's got the name of the person who used to live here. I guess the sender hasn’t updated their address. I was thinking, maybe we could jot down a quick note and send it back with the package. That way, they'll know what happened, and the post office can probably forward it to the right place. Or, if you know the previous tenant, we could just give it to them directly. What do you think? It's a small thing, but it could make someone's day to get something they were expecting.
